description: Shared cases for core webhookMessage and webhookUrlProblem: the accountability sentence plus the item breakdown that only the webhook gets. `when` and each item's `amount` are already-formatted client strings, so both cores produce identical messages.

message_cases.name: sentence then breakdown
message_cases.expect:
As of 9/20/26, 12:24:58 PM CDT my blood sugar is 170. I am eating something with 59 carbs and so am giving myself 7 units of fast acting insulin.

In it:
• Cheerios — 1 cup · 24 g carbs
• Milk, 2% — 8 fl oz · 12 g carbs
• Banana — 1 medium (118 g) · 23 g carbs

message_cases.name: no items is the sentence alone
message_cases.expect: As of 9/20/26, 12:24:58 PM CDT my blood sugar is 170. I am eating something with 59 carbs and so am giving myself 7 units of fast acting insulin.

message_cases.name: an item with no amount shows only its carbs
message_cases.expect:
As of 5/1/26, 9:30:00 AM CDT my blood sugar is 88. I am eating something with 23 carbs and so am giving myself 2 units of fast acting insulin.

In it:
• Gatorade — 23 g carbs

message_cases.name: a missing carbs snapshot is left out, never printed as NaN
message_cases.expect:
As of 5/1/26, 9:30:00 AM CDT I do not have a blood sugar reading. I am eating something with 12 carbs and have not recorded a dose yet.

In it:
• Leftovers — 1 serving

message_cases.name: carb figures drop trailing zeros and round to one decimal
message_cases.expect:
As of 3/4/26, 6:15:00 PM CST my blood sugar is 120. I am eating something with 59 carbs and so am giving myself 6.25 units of fast acting insulin.

In it:
• Rice — 150 g · 45 g carbs
• Sauce — 2 tbsp · 14 g carbs

message_cases.name: over the limit the tail is replaced with a count, never the sentence
message_cases.expect:
As of 9/20/26, 12:24:58 PM CDT my blood sugar is 170. I am eating something with 59 carbs and so am giving myself 7 units of fast acting insulin.

In it:
• Cheerios — 1 cup · 24 g carbs
• …and 2 more

message_cases.name: a limit too small for any breakdown keeps the sentence whole
message_cases.expect: As of 9/20/26, 12:24:58 PM CDT my blood sugar is 170. I am eating something with 59 carbs and so am giving myself 7 units of fast acting insulin.
